mapper.sql: FROM bpm_business_approval_request br JOIN mes_pro_edhr_batch_execution b ON CAST(CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY)=CAST(br.object_id AS BINARY) AND b.tenant_id=br.tenant_id AND b.deleted=0 JOIN mes_pro_edhr_record_change_event e ON e.batch_execution_id=b.id AND e.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND e.deleted=0 AND CAST(e.bpm_process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) AND e.change_type='VOID' AND e.target_scope='BATCH' AND e.change_status='SUBMITTED' WHERE br.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND br.deleted=0 AND br.request_status='PENDING_BPM' AND CAST(br.process_instance_id AS BINARY)=CAST(t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS BINARY) AND CAST(br.process_definition_key AS BINARY)=CAST(d.KEY_ AS BINARY) AND br.system_code='MES' AND br.data_domain='MES' AND br.object_type='EDHR_BATCH_EXECUTION' AND br.action_code='VOID' AND o.authority_type='BUSINESS_REQUEST' AND o.projection_code='NATIVE_BUSINESS' AND o.writer_code='BUSINESS_APPROVAL_SUBMIT' AND CAST(CAST(br.id AS CHAR) AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_id AS BINARY) AND CAST(br.object_version AS BINARY)=CAST(o.authority_version AS BINARY) AND CAST(p.BUSINESS_KEY_ AS BINARY)=CAST(CONCAT('BUSINESS_APPROVAL:',br.id) AS BINARY) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_RU_VARIABLE v WHERE v.PROC_INST_ID_=t.PROC_INST_ID_ AND CAST(v.NAME_ AS BINARY)=CAST('businessType' AS BINARY) AND CAST(v.TEXT_ AS BINARY)=CAST('EDHR_BATCH_EXECUTION_VOID' AS BINARY) AND v.TASK_ID_ IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WHERE AND (SELECT COUNT(*) ) != 1
mapper.sql: SELECT 'BPM_EDHR_VOID' AS source_id, t.ID_ AS row_order_key, t.ID_ AS business_id, CONCAT('BPM_EDHR_VOID:',t.ID_) AS task_key, '批记录' AS task_type, '批次作废审批' AS source, CONCAT('批次作废 · ',t.NAME_,' · 流程 ',t.PROC_INST_ID_) AS detail, '待审批' AS status_label, t.CREATE_TIME_ AS created_at, t.DUE_DATE_ AS due_at, t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS process_instance_id FROM WHERE AND EXISTS ()
